title: 'The Wreckers' Roost' quest text says the roost is 'a palisade east along the shore from the quay, past the dunes,' but going east from Gullhaven's quay leads straight onto the Fenmarch coast road, not toward any dunes or palisade. The only wrecker-related content actually found (The Weir, a wrecker scout, the Weeping Caves) was reached via an unrelated southward cliff path from the Farlight/Point. Both 'The Wreckers' Roost' and 'The Missing Nets' were left permanently unresolved despite deliberately searching along the hinted direction.
where: The Quay, Gullhaven / 'go east (toward the coast road)'

evidence.quote: 'The Wreckers' Roost' quest text reads 'a palisade east along the shore from the quay, past the dunes,' but the literal east exit from the Quay leads to 'Saltkerns Coast Road' toward Fenmarch — a different hold entirely, with no dunes or roost anywhere on it. Never located the actual Roost in the time spent.
